name: [UPD] Build an Empire 🏰
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Build an Empire! ⚔️

Start with a tiny piece of land and slowly turn it into a huge empire.

[HOW TO PLAY]:
🏰 Build farms, mines, houses, castles and more.
👥 Grow your population and watch civilians work around your empire.
💰 Produce resources, sell them and keep getting richer.
🔬 Research upgrades and unlock stronger buildings and skills.
⚔️ Build an army with soldiers, Giants, Medics and siege weapons.
🚩 Fight other empires, capture flags and take control of the map.
👑 Upgrade your Empire Level and be the best!

Build. Grow. Fight. Conquer. RTS.

[EXTRA]:
🍀 Premium gives you +5% sell value bonus.
🎖️ Join the group for +10% sell value bonus.
🏗️ Your empire works offline!
🛠️ More updates to come!
